owner_instruction: そうですね。そのやり方でパラメータ調整に区切りをつけましょう。最後に選ばれたものとやねうらおうのレベル48から1ずつ上げていくのもしてもらって、現行とm型と比較してください。まずはそこまでお願いします
scope: One final parameter-search cycle, select one candidate, final internal comparison, Material ladder and comparison report. Do not start search-efficiency research.

followup.ranking: descending minimum(M score,Q14 score), then descending mean, then index ascending; choose top six new candidates subject to family maximum two; add frozen UNIFIED(25),ATTACK_AVG(30). Override generated round2-followup.json. No new20 generation.

candidate_selection: Rank followup minimum(M,Q14), then mean. Exact tie prefer UNIFIED25, then lower index. If leading candidate is not UNIFIED and has min score <= UNIFIED min score, use UNIFIED. Freeze one selected profile/ref before final results.

final.criterion: wins > losses against BOTH controls (score>50%), without requiring statistical significance; report uncertainty.

fallback: If selected new candidate fails either control, end adjustment and choose frozen UNIFIED based on completed independent 600/control results. Do not test repeated candidates until one wins.

comparison.reuse: Reuse completed matching formal M/Q14 ladders after verifying fixed refs, actual settings, knowledge identity, Material nodes and results; if unverifiable, rerun only necessary comparisons.

stop_point: After selected candidate ladder completes, verify raw/summary/illegal/settings/color/records/artifact expiry and report per-level candidate/current/M comparison. Keep candidate unpromoted unless owner explicitly adopts it; stop tracking after final report. No additional parameter cycle or efficiency research.
